第15章 打三皇子的人（第1页）
宗主上官云道，师弟这次出去回来就搞出那么大动静？外面世界怎么样了？
“太上诸葛天也看向副宗主张洪”。
两人不约而同的看向张洪，我本以为以我的境界能轻松横跨海域。谁知还没走出海域，就被海妖大能给轰飞了回来，受了很重的伤，而且那海妖我竟然看不透实力。养了好久伤才回来，这次回来不走了。就在宗门看着这帮小家伙，看谁能走出去。
三人聊到很晚才散去，也了解外面世界的广阔。
另一边，李天王维还有林耀三人一起回到李天的住所。
李天安慰道，林兄。别气馁，今年不行明年，至少还有机会提升实力。
看着自己空荡的另一只手臂，心情很是落寞。然后告别李天，独自回到自己的地方疗伤去了。
王维看着李天，今天真的是太凶险!实力没到之前你应该隐忍，别一味的冒险知道吗？白白牺牲自己的命。
我就想知道那个副宗主怎么回事？我从小在宗门长大从来没有遇见过他？。
对于李天的疑问他还是知道点那个副宗主，那是个神龙不见尾的人，很少有人看到他在宗门，据说十年前就没在宗门了。那家伙嗜酒如命，人还是挺好的。帮理不帮亲的人。行事风格很不一样，想必今天你也见识到了!
他和宗主之间关系很好，就是不知道啥关系，我们也不敢问，只了解大概这些。
好了我先走了，宗门还有许多事要忙。李天目送着王维离开，回想起过去的种种印像，今天的确是这样感受了不一样的宗门，还有这一号人物，自己在元神宗长大的。也从来没见过宗主，还有那位太上。
李天进入天书修炼了，今天的实战对于自己很有帮助，必须去好好感悟一下。就这样修炼了一晚上。
清晨，李天从天书内出来。感受着自己实力有所精进。却被一声敲门声打断，来人同样是元神宗弟子。
来人开口很高傲，这引起了李天的不满。
你谁啊？来时不敲门，不得到房子主人允许就私自闯入别人家？
我是三皇子的管家，我们三皇子是精英弟子，叫你去他那里一叙。

你们三皇子是谁？我不知道，凭借你这样的态度我觉得他不是什么好人。要想找我叫他自己来!我没兴趣去见他。
我们三皇子是天武域刘氏皇朝三皇子，叫你见他是给你面子，说白了就是想让你为他效力，看中你的天赋了，给他效力，荣华富贵想之不尽，别不知好歹。
志气高昂的样子这就是你们的态度。我数三声，再不滚？赏你吃巴掌。
或许是背靠大势力嚣张跋扈习惯了，见谁都一副高高在上的样子。这管家竟然不走？
李天也没有耐心和他纠缠，上去就是几大嘴巴子，牙齿都脱落了好几颗
这管家跟死狗一样捂住嘴，牙齿漏风，说话都说不清了，只能勉勉强强听懂。我是三皇子的人，你打了我等于打了三皇子，你就等着被株连九族吧!。说着不要命的往外跑，生怕李天追来!。

Chapter 15 The man who beat the third prince (page 1)
Sect leader Shangguan Yun said, Junior Brother made such a big noise when he came back from going out this time? How is the world outside?
"Tai Shang Zhuge Tian also looked at Deputy Sect Zhang Hong."
The two of them looked at Zhang Hong in unison. I thought I could easily cross the sea with my level. Unexpectedly, before I even got out of the sea, I was blasted back by the powerful sea monster. I was seriously injured, and I couldn't see through the strength of the sea monster. It took me a long time to recover from my injuries before I came back, and I won’t leave this time. The sect was watching these little guys to see who could get out.
The three of them chatted until very late and then dispersed, understanding the vastness of the outside world.
On the other side, Li Tian, ​​Wang Wei and Lin Yao returned to Li Tian's residence together.
Li Tian comforted him, Brother Lin. Don't be discouraged, if it doesn't work this year, then next year, at least there will be a chance to improve your strength.
Looking at his empty other arm, he felt very lonely. Then he said goodbye to Li Tian and returned to his own place to heal.
Wang Wei looked at Li Tian, ​​"Today is really dangerous! You should be patient until your strength is up, don't take risks blindly, you know?" Sacrifice your life in vain.
I just want to know what happened to the deputy sect leader? I grew up in the sect and never met him? .
Regarding Li Tian's question, he still knew something about the deputy sect leader. He was a man who never saw the end of the dragon. Few people saw him in the sect. It was said that he had not been in the sect ten years ago. The guy was a heavy drinker, but he was quite nice. Help those who care but not relatives. The style of acting is very different, and you must have seen it today!
He has a very good relationship with the sect leader. Even if we don’t know what the relationship is, we don’t dare to ask. We only know about this.
Okay, I'll leave first. The sect still has many things to be busy with. Li Tian watched Wang Wei leave and recalled all the impressions from the past. Today, he indeed felt a different sect and this person. He grew up in the Yuanshen Sect. I have never seen the sect master or the Supreme Being.
Li Tian has entered the Heavenly Book to practice. Today's actual combat is very helpful to him, so he must understand it carefully. I practiced like this all night.
In the early morning, Li Tian came out of the Book of Heaven. Feeling that my strength has improved. But he was interrupted by a knock on the door. The person who came was also a disciple of Yuanshen Sect.
The visitor spoke very arrogantly, which aroused Li Tian's dissatisfaction.
Who are you? Not knocking on the door when you come, breaking into other people's homes without the permission of the owner of the house?
I am the steward of the third prince. Our third prince is an elite disciple. I want you to go to his place and talk to him.
Who is your third prince? I don't know, with your attitude I don't think he's a good person. If you want to find me, ask him to come by himself! I have no interest in meeting him.
Our third prince is the third prince of the Liu Dynasty in the Tianwu Region. He asked you to meet him to give you face. To put it bluntly, he wants you to work for him. He has taken a fancy to your talent. If you work for him, you will have endless dreams of glory and wealth. Don't be ignorant.
High ambition is your attitude. I count to three, why don't you get out? Give you a slap in the face.
Perhaps because he was used to being arrogant and domineering with the backing of big forces, he looked aloof to everyone he saw. The butler didn't even leave?
Li Tian didn't have the patience to fight with him. He had a big mouth when he went up and several teeth fell out.
The butler covered his mouth like a dead dog, his teeth were leaking, and he couldn't speak clearly. He could only barely understand. I am a member of the Third Prince. If you hit me, it is equivalent to hitting the Third Prince. Just wait until you are implicated in the nine clans! He said and ran out desperately, for fear that Li Tian would chase him!
